title: AUTH_OK payload
description: Sent by the daemon on successful authentication. Followed immediately by a SNAPSHOT. See SRD Section 7.5.

session_id.description: Opaque identifier for this WebSocket session (unique per connection).

device_name.description: The human-readable name of the authenticated device.

protocol_version.description: Confirmed protocol version for this session.

server_time_ms.description: Daemon wall clock in milliseconds since the Unix epoch at the time of AUTH_OK.

limits.description: Effective per-session limits for this connection.

max_frame_bytes.description: Maximum inbound frame size in bytes.
